item.title: Chandler Halderson Faked College Emails To Fool His Father
item.description: Chandler Halderson impersonated college employees to make his parents believe he was still enrolled. Prosecutors said he killed Bart and Krista Halderson in Wisconsin in 2021 after his father uncovered the deception. He was convicted in 2022 and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: The Withheld Evidence That Ended Alec Baldwin’s Trial
item.description: Alec Baldwin’s manslaughter case over Halyna Hutchins’ death on the “Rust” set was permanently dismissed in 2024 after ammunition evidence was withheld. In September 2026, a judge dismissed most claims against prosecutors in his subsequent lawsuit, while allowing others to proceed.

item.title: She Vanished After Leaving A Bar With An Ex-Officer
item.description: Gretchen Fleming, 27, disappeared after leaving a Parkersburg, West Virginia, bar in December 2022. DNA testing identified remains found by a hunter in 2025. Former officer Preston Pierce, the last person seen with her, was charged with murder and kidnapping in 2026. He has pleaded not guilty.

item.title: His Prison DNA Test Exposed A Decades-Old Crime
item.description: Former Arkansas police chief Grant Hardin pleaded guilty to James Appleton’s 2017 murder. DNA collected when he entered prison then linked him to a teacher’s unsolved 1997 rape. He pleaded guilty in that case in 2019 and received an additional 50-year sentence.

item.title: Her Killer Was Wearing A GPS Monitor The Entire Time
item.description: Ohio State student Reagan Tokes was abducted after leaving work in Columbus in February 2017. DNA and data from Brian Golsby’s ankle monitor linked him to her murder. He was convicted in 2018 and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: Google Street View Captured Her Car After She Vanished
item.description: Arelie Garcia, 25, disappeared from Salinas, California, on September 22, 2022. Her car was found in Big Sur with her phone and wallet inside—and appeared in a Google Street View image taken that day. She remains missing, and police continue investigating.
